next_item_hypothesis: Observed train-only directed transitions (0.9266197178950221 of directed pairs have no observed reverse event; mean next-item entropy 4.844072338042215 bits) motivate testing whether asymmetric coarse-to-fine item neighborhoods benefit from a negatively curved residual code geometry. These statistics do not demonstrate hierarchy, negative curvature, or improved prediction. Freeze the hypothesis that Poincare residual vector quantization yields more useful global three-token item SIDs for downstream Stage3 next-item ranking than the matched flat metric.

math_definition.architecture: For each item i, its content embedding x_i is passed through the existing content encoder f_theta to z_i in R^32. Map z_i to the Poincare ball with exp^c_0. Quantize sequentially at levels l=1,2,3: level 1 quantizes the current point; each later level quantizes the Mobius residual after subtracting the previous reconstruction. Each level has exactly 256 globally shared code vectors in the same 32-dimensional ball. Emit SID(i)=(k_i1,k_i2,k_i3), one global three-token SID per item; no user or history input enters Stage2.

frozen_constants.arcosh_stable: arcosh_stable(u)=log(u+sqrt(max(u-1,0))*sqrt(max(u+1,0))) for u>=1; clamp the computed distance argument to at least 1.
frozen_constants.domain_policy: All ball points are projected to the open radius r after every exp/map/add operation; distance arguments are clamped to >=1. Euclidean flat arm does not use ball projection or arcosh.
frozen_constants.c_to_0_limits: For every c-dependent rule: d_c(x,y)^2 -> 4*||x-y||^2; exp^c_0(v) -> v (identity); the radius (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c) is undefined at c=0 and is not applied in the flat arm, which uses unconstrained R^32 vectors. Mobius addition/subtraction and Poincare residual quantization are replaced in the flat arm by ordinary addition/subtraction and Euclidean residual quantization; its squared metric is exactly 4*||x-y||^2.

math_definition.named_tensor_shapes: N training items in a batch; z:[N,32], q_l:[N,32], residual r_l:[N,32], codebook C_l:[256,32], assignments k_l:[N] with k_l in {0,...,255}, reconstructed y:[N,32]. D is the fixed training-transition multiset of ordered item pairs (a,b), with pair embeddings z_a,z_b. All Stage2 item content embeddings and transition pairs come from the training split only.
math_definition.distance: For ball points x,y, d_c(x,y)^2=(4/c)*arcosh_stable(1+2*c*||x-y||^2/((1-c*||x||^2)*(1-c*||y||^2)))^2; denominators use projected points and are positive by the domain policy.
math_definition.maps: exp^c_0(v)=tanh(sqrt(c)*||v||)*v/(sqrt(c)*||v||), with value 0 at ||v||=0, followed by projection. Mobius addition is x (+_c) y=((1+2c<x,y>+c||y||^2)x+(1-c||x||^2)y)/(1+2c<x,y>+c^2||x||^2||y||^2), followed by projection; x (-_c) y=x (+_c) (-y).
math_definition.residual_assignment: Set r_1=exp^c_0(z). For l=1,2,3, k_il=argmin_{j in 0..255} d_c(r_il,C_lj)^2, with ties resolved by smallest j; q_il=C_l,k_il; r_i,l+1=r_il (-_c) q_il for l<3. Reconstruct y_i=q_i1 (+_c) q_i2 (+_c) q_i3, evaluated left-to-right and projected after each addition. Later levels condition exactly on earlier assigned codes k_i1,...,k_i,l-1 via the residual; there is no other conditioning.
math_definition.losses_and_targets: Define stopgrad as identity forward/no gradient; sg tensors are detached. The sole content objective is L_content=(1/N) sum_i [d_c(stopgrad(exp^c_0(z_i)),y_i)^2 + sum_{l=1}^3 d_c(stopgrad(r_il),q_il)^2 + sum_{l=1}^3 d_c(r_il,stopgrad(q_il))^2], respectively reconstruction, codebook, and commitment terms; commitment terms are multiplied by frozen beta=0.25 (equivalently replace their coefficient 1 by beta). To remove ambiguity, the actual coefficients are 1 for reconstruction, 1 for codebook, and beta=0.25 for commitment. Assignment argmins and residuals for later levels use detached earlier q values, while codebook losses update only the selected C_l and commitment losses update the encoder. Empty N defines L_content=0.
math_definition.train_transition_signal: Let D={(a_m,b_m)}_{m=1..M} be consecutive item pairs from training histories only. Form target p_mj=softmax_j(-stopgrad(d_c(exp^c_0(z_a_m),C_1j)^2)/tau), j=0..255, and predicted s_mj=softmax_j(-d_c(exp^c_0(z_b_m),C_1j)^2/tau). L_transition=-(1/M) sum_m sum_j p_mj log(max(s_mj,epsilon)); empty M defines L_transition=0. The stopgrad in p explicitly breaks target/parameter circularity. Stage2 objective is L_content+lambda_transition*L_transition with frozen lambda_transition=0.1. This auxiliary signal trains only from training-split consecutive pairs; it does not use validation/test events, future events, user context at prediction time, or batch composition as a target. No user-level bootstrap or candidate ranking is performed.
math_definition.diagnostics: On the fixed Stage2 validation item set (content only; no validation behavior used for training): Hard-L1 ER is mean number of unequal SID tokens versus the frozen Stage2 reference target, divided by 3; distinct two-token prefixes is the count of unique (k1,k2); L3 collision is the fraction of items sharing their full three-token SID with at least one other item; refinement gain is mean [d_c(x,q1)^2-d_c(x,y)^2] divided by max(mean d_c(x,q1)^2,epsilon); conditional G3 is mean per-(k1,k2) normalized entropy of k3, averaged over occupied prefixes, with empty groups omitted and all-empty value 0. These are diagnostics only, not ranking outcomes.

hyperbolic_necessity: The candidate failure is excessive collision of behaviorally distinct items under flat coarse-to-fine residual quantization: repeated asymmetric train transitions suggest that neighborhoods may branch with depth rather than lie on a uniform-scale flat geometry. Negative curvature is a plausible inductive bias because it provides expanding volume with radius, potentially allocating representational capacity to branching/coarse-to-fine structure. Evidence is indirect: the supplied behavior statistics establish directionality and entropy only, while cited Poincare work concerns hierarchy and TIGER concerns generative semantic IDs; neither demonstrates their combination or proves that this failure occurs. The test is therefore a falsifiable geometry hypothesis, not a claim of necessity established by evidence.
euclidean_control: Run a matched flat arm with identical content encoder, three 256x32 codebooks, transition auxiliary objective, parameters, initialization distribution, optimizer, schedule, seeds, data split, training budget and stopping rule. Change only the metric/geometry: squared distance is 4*||x-y||^2, exp is identity, no ball projection, and residual/addition are ordinary Euclidean operations. Include a separate graph-signal arm only as the prespecified graph comparison: same flat architecture and all protocol settings, plus the same L_transition over the training transition multiset; this is not the geometry-only control. No arm uses ranking, beam search, prefix Transformers, NDCG/Recall, or user bootstrap. Freeze optimizer=Adam, learning_rate=0.001, batch_size=1024 items, epochs=100, cosine schedule with 5-epoch linear warmup, seeds=[17,29,43], codebook initialization=content-encoder outputs of 256 distinct training items per level chosen by seeded k-means++ (same sampled item IDs and initial tensors across paired arms). No sweep.
effect_site: Stage2 code assignment, codebook geometry, and reconstruction/commitment objective only; the transition auxiliary loss is identical across hyperbolic and Euclidean geometry arms. Expected Stage2 diagnostic directions versus geometry-only Euclidean: lower Hard-L1 ER, more distinct two-token prefixes, lower L3 collision, higher refinement gain, and higher conditional G3 (without collapsing into unoccupied-prefix artifacts; empty groups are excluded). These are leading indicators, not proof of Stage3 ranking improvement.
real_trigger_measurement: Freeze the Stage2 validation diagnostic computation and the Stage3 behavioral test as separate preregistered evaluations. Stage3 test_R@10 is the primary behavioral metric: mean per-user recall@10 on the existing test split, with the same fixed Stage3 T5 ranker, candidates and evaluation code for all SID arms; no test data may affect Stage2 or model selection. Required direction is improvement over geometry-only Euclidean, minimum +0.005 absolute test_R@10, and seed rule is paired per-seed differences for seeds 17,29,43, with at least 2/3 seeds meeting the threshold and the three-seed mean positive. If the project’s registered primary metric is NDCG@10 instead, register NDCG@10 before any Stage3 run and require +0.005 absolute under the same seed rule; do not choose the metric after seeing results. Stage2 validation diagnostics never substitute for this test.
training_only_inputs: Stage2 content embeddings/items and consecutive transitions from the training split only, permitted by CLAUDE.md rule 16. No validation/test behavior, future events, prediction-time user context, or batch composition is a supervision signal or target. Validation is used only for frozen diagnostics; test is used only for the separately registered Stage3 final behavioral measurement.

falsifier.seed_combination: For each diagnostic, compute paired hyperbolic-minus-Euclidean difference for seeds 17,29,43. A diagnostic passes only if at least 2 of 3 seeds meet its stated directional minimum and the mean paired difference across all three seeds meets that same directional minimum.
falsifier.classification: Supported Stage2 mechanism only if all five diagnostic thresholds pass. Falsified if all five are null/opposite (no seed reaches the directional minimum for any diagnostic, or pooled means are zero/opposite). Mixed otherwise, including any combination of passed and failed/null diagnostics. Regardless of Stage2 classification, Stage3 behavior is successful only if the independently registered test_R@10 or NDCG@10 criterion in real_trigger_measurement passes; Stage2 success with Stage3 null/opposite is not a recommendation improvement.
falsifier.stage3_behavioral_falsifier: Metric: preregistered test_R@10 (primary) or, if explicitly registered before runs, test NDCG@10. Direction: higher than matched geometry-only Euclidean. Minimum: +0.005 absolute. Seed rule: paired seeds 17,29,43; at least 2/3 paired differences >=+0.005 and three-seed mean >=+0.005. Mixed/null/opposite is failure to establish behavioral improvement, even if Stage2 diagnostics improve.
